positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• As blik’s first employee, designed and implemented from scratch their RF-based low-power indoor localization algorithm running across their IoT Sensor, RF edge gateway and cloud server.
    • Developed low-power sensor drivers and applications for blik’s IoT devices on Contiki & RIOT OS.
    • On blik’s RF edge gateway, implemented device drivers, libraries and applications in Python.
    • Extended an IEEE 802.15.4 Linux kernel driver to support blik’s localization technology.
    • Established software testing procedures and hardware deployment processes to ensure reliable and scalable deployments of blik’s RF edge gateway to pilot customers.
    • My work played a crucial role in blik winning 2nd place at Techcrunch Disrupt Berlin 2017.

positions.title: Research Assistant/Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Designed and developed the “Secure IoT SoC Lab” from scratch.  This included writing firmware for the BLE nRF51822 SoC utilizing the LwIP stack, writing firmware for an FPGA SoC utilizing mbed TLS and MQTT and configuring a Raspberry Pi as a BLE 6LoWPAN gateway.
- Supervised and supported students in the lab with their FPGA SoC design and embedded software development.
- Prototyped FPGA ARM SoCs used to study ARM’s security vulnerabilities to side-channel attacks.
Developed a hardware bootloader in VHDL to enable flashing of the SoC’s BRAM via UART.

company.name: Qwello
company.description:
Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Qwello is a fast-growing, full-service builder, owner, and operator of electric vehicle charging infrastructure in major European cities. We are focused on the provision of public charging infrastructure and committed to simplifying urban e-mobility for everyone.

Qwello operates over 15,000 charge points via public concessions with local municipalities and the investment of private capital. We deliver turnkey solutions to cities — covering all elements of planning, installation, operation, and service for public charging infrastructure.

Our operations span Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, the UK, France, Spain, and Poland. With a clear commitment to the European market, the highest ESG standards, and strong support for decarbonisation, Qwello is helping to build the urban mobility of tomorrow.

We’re a fast-growing team driven by purpose and innovation. We believe the best products are built by inclusive, diverse, and collaborative teams — and we’re always looking for people who want to shape the future of e-mobility.

➡️ Learn more at www.qwello.eu/en
